jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Developer - Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U)

Do you want to make the world a safer place while being part of a team that truly values experience and collaboration?

Would you like to join a global and technically skilled team that plays an essential role in Verisure’s success?

The platform organisation in Malmö develops and operates the software that underpins Verisure's alarm and smart home systems. We are responsible for the services that keep millions of connected devices online, upgradeable, and traceable, from the moment a device is manufactured until it is returned or decommissioned.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Developer in Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U), you will join a team of around 11 backend engineers building and operating a portfolio of internal platform services. These cover device lifecycle management (factory provisioning, firmware upgrades, SIM management) and internal operator and support tooling used daily by Verisure technicians and administrators. Several of these services run with 24/7 SLA requirements; device provisioning and support tooling are business-critical, always-on parts of the platform.

You will design, build, and operate microservices spanning device lifecycle management, SIM connectivity, firmware/upgrade orchestration, and internal utility tooling. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner, fellow developers, and PU&U's external EMS partners to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into reliable software. You are expected to take technical ownership of parts of the system, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor less experienced developers.

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation, not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages, spanning millions of connected devices, is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Location:
Malmö (5-minute walk from the Central Station)

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation — not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages — spanning millions of connected devices — is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced backend developer with a strong technical foundation and the confidence to take ownership of complex, business-critical services. You enjoy working in an environment with a long-term technical vision but shifting short-term priorities, and you communicate clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders. You take pride in code quality, system reliability, and helping the team improve its ways of working.

Required

Several years of hands-on experience as a backend software developer, ideally in a microservice/distributed systems environment
Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot
Experience with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)
Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Also, Great If You Have

Experience with message-driven architecture (e.g. RabbitMQ)
Experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL)
Frontend experience (React/JavaScript) is a plus, though not the core focus of the role
Familiarity with device lifecycle management, IoT connectivity, or hardware/software integration
Experience working in an environment with external hardware/manufacturing partners
AWS experience

About Verisure

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!

If you have questions regarding this position, please reach out to our Group Senior TA Specialist, Robert Jonasson, at robert.jonasson@verisure.com

Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.

Verisure - 35 years of delivering peace of mind.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We make cargo talk. Why? Because a third of all food and pharma produce is wasted on the way to consumers, and we're out to change that. Our smart tracker Emma, made from recycled ocean plastic, travels with temperature-sensitive shipments for enterprise customers in food, pharma and seafood across 20+ countries. We're looking for a seasoned engineer to own the platform behind it, and to build it for ten times the fleet we run today.

What you'll do Own our Azure cloud platform end to end: architecture, ingestion, data, cost, and the calls about what we run and why.
Push AI-assisted development further than most dare. Claude writes most of our code and a human owns every merge. You'll define how far that goes for production infrastructure, and build the guardrails.
Scale ingestion and the data tier for a fast-growing fleet, without per-device cloud cost rising with it.
Make reliability unremarkable: no reading silently lost, late and backfilled data handled gracefully, and monitoring that spots trouble before a customer does.
Grow the data platform so questions about the fleet or a single shipment are answered in seconds, not filed as tickets.

Our stack A cloud-native platform on Azure: event-driven IoT ingestion, serverless services, and both operational and analytical data stores. CI/CD carries much of what we ship, a human reviews every change, and turning more of our infrastructure into code is a job we want you to own. AI runs through development, operations and analysis, and we are leaning into what is now just possible. We're ISO 27001 certified and our customers are audited, so security shapes real engineering decisions. We'll go through the details with you in the interview.

What you bring Deep experience in building and operating production cloud infrastructure: Azure, or another major cloud and the appetite to go Azure-deep.
Real conviction about AI-assisted development, with the judgement to know when to slow down and verify.
A curious, fast-learning mind. Being a jack-of-all-trades is a real plus here.
Fluency with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability.
Strong Postgres and SQL, and sound instincts for modelling time-series data at volume.

Nice to have: IoT or telemetry at fleet scale, cellular (LTE-M, NB-IoT), ISO 27001/SOC 2 environments, Python, and cloud cost engineering.

What we offer Competitive salary, good pension, and share options. Own a piece of what you build.
Flexible hours and location; a welcoming office at Kjelsås Stasjon with parking and good transit connections. Our team tends to spend about half their time at the HQ.
Your choice of tools, plus best-in-class AI tools with generous quotas.
